facts.fact: The World Bank's WDI lists the 2022 Demographic and Health Survey and Malaria Indicator Survey as Tanzania's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
facts.system: Demographic and Health Survey and Malaria Indicator Survey 2022

facts.fact: The World Bank's WDI lists an expenditure survey/budget survey (ES/BS) of 2011/12 as the source of Tanzania's most recent income and expenditure data.
